page_title: PAL 1-1 MAL | Las Palmas v Mallorca 12/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+7' The ball goes out of play and Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick.

90+7' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the crossbar. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Alvaro Valles with a fabulous save.
90+6' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is flagged for offside.
90+4' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) rises above the defence to meet a cross from the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches wide of the right post.
90+3' It will be a corner kick for Mallorca.
90+3' Mallorca take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
88' Las Palmas have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
85' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Omenuke Mfulu (Las Palmas) replacing Kirian.
85' Here's the change. Manu Morlanes leaves the pitch and Javier Llabres (Mallorca) comes on as a substitute.
84' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) gets a yellow card.
84' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Alvaro Lemos (Las Palmas) gets booked.

79' Ambitious effort from Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
77' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
75' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.

70' 1 - 1 The ball was swung into the box by Sergi Darder from the corner kick. He perfectly found the head of Antonio Raillo (Mallorca), who planted a long-range header inside the right post to make the score 1:1.
70' Mallorca force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
68' Las Palmas work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
68' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas). The ball is out of play and Las Palmas manage to earn a corner.
67' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Sergi Darder (Mallorca) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
64' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta decides to make a substitution. Marc Cardona Rovira will be replaced by Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas).
64' The referee signals a substitution. Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) is brought on as a substitute for Daley Sinkgraven.
63' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is adjudged offside.
63' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is penalised for holding. Victor Garcia signals a set piece.
61' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
60' The substitution is prepared. Cyle Larin (Mallorca) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Amath Ndiaye.
60' Here is a change. Omar Mascarell is going off and Javier Aguirre gives the last tactical orders to Samuel Costa (Mallorca).
57' Alvaro Lemos (Las Palmas) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
56' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) is penalised for a foul. Victor Garcia had a clear view and blows his whistle.
54' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
53' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) was quite harsh and Victor Garcia didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
53' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
52' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
51' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
50' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Predrag Rajkovic easily deals with the threat.
46' Javier Aguirre has made a change at the break. Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) has come on in place of Jose Copete.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sergi Darder (Mallorca) replaces Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' Victor Garcia blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+6' A goal, which was scored by Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca), was disallowed due to offside.
45+3' Predrag Rajkovic displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
45+2' Handball by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca).
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
43' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mallorca comes to nothing.
41' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) misses the penalty as he smashes the ball against the crossbar!
41' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
39' The referee has issued a yellow card to Kirian (Las Palmas).
39' Kirian (Las Palmas) brings his opponent down. Victor Garcia has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Mallorca are given a penalty!
35' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Mallorca was in an offside position.
31' A cooling break is underway.
29' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) into the top left hand corner, giving goalkeeper Predrag Rajkovic no chance!
28' Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
28' Jose Copete (Mallorca) gets booked for the first time in this match.
28' The Las Palmas players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

27' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Las Palmas.
26' PENALTY APPEAL by Las Palmas, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
26' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
25' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
22' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) smashed a volley without hesitation from near the penalty spot, but it only rattled the left post!
20' Daley Sinkgraven (Las Palmas) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
19' Kirian (Las Palmas) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Predrag Rajkovic comes off the line to clear the ball away.
16' One of the Las Palmas players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
14' Victor Garcia interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alex Cardero (Las Palmas).
12' Kirian (Las Palmas) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Predrag Rajkovic intercepts the ball.
10' The players claim that Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
9' Las Palmas show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
6' Victor Garcia couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jose Copete (Mallorca) and blew his whistle.
3' Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) takes the corner with a short pass.
3' Alvaro Lemos (Las Palmas) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Las Palmas win a corner kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
Las Palmas will kick the game off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Today's referee will be Victor Garcia.
